episodeTitle.en: The engineering mindset | Will Larson (Carta, Stripe, Uber, Calm, Digg)
episodeTitle.zh: 工程师思维模式 | 威尔·拉森（Will Larson，曾就职于Carta、Stripe、Uber、Calm、Digg）

guestBioOfficial.en: Will Larson is the chief technology officer at Carta. Prior to joining Carta, he was the CTO at Calm and held engineering leadership roles at Stripe, Uber, and Digg. He is the author of two foundational engineering career books, An Elegant Puzzle and Staff Engineer, and The Engineering Executive’s Primer, which will be released in February of next year. In our conversation, we discuss: • Systems thinking: what it is and how to apply it
guestBioOfficial.zh: 威尔·拉森（Will Larson）是Carta的首席技术官。在加入Carta之前，他曾担任Calm的CTO，并在Stripe、Uber和Digg担任过工程领导职务。他是两本基础工程职业书籍《An Elegant Puzzle》和《Staff Engineer》的作者，《The Engineering Executive’s Primer》将于明年二月出版。在我们的对话中，我们将讨论： • 系统思维：其定义及应用方式

title.en: The engineering mindset | Will Larson (Carta, Stripe, Uber, Calm, Digg)
title.zh: 工程师思维模式 | 威尔·拉森（Will Larson，曾就职于Carta、Stripe、Uber、Calm、Digg）

summary.en: Will shares advice on developing your engineering strategy and strategy in general, the staff/principal engineer path, and what it takes to operate as an engineering executive. He discusses how to think about org design, where technical leaders should focus, and lessons from scaling engineering at Stripe, Uber, and Carta. The episode is a must-read-listener's guide to the engineering leadership ladder.
summary.zh: Will 分享了关于制定工程战略（以及广义战略）的建议、Staff/首席工程师（principal）的成长路径，以及作为工程高管运作需要什么。他讨论了如何思考组织设计、技术领导者应当聚焦何处，以及从在 Stripe、Uber 和 Carta 规模化工程中得到的经验。本期是面向必读听众的、关于工程领导力阶梯的指南。
